title: Google's Priciest Subscription Goes Family.. YouTube Premium for the Whole Family at No Extra Cost! 🏠
body: Google's Priciest Subscription Goes Family.. YouTube Premium for the Whole Family at No Extra Cost! 🏠

Google announced yesterday that its top AI package, "AI Ultra", now includes family YouTube Premium instead of the individual plan, with no increase in price. The benefit covers both Ultra packages: Ultra 5X at $99.99 a month and Ultra 20X at $199.99 a month.

The Ultra subscription used to include YouTube Premium for one person only; now the subscriber can add up to five family members in the same household, who can watch YouTube and listen to YouTube Music without ads, with background playback and offline downloads. The YouTube Premium family plan alone costs $26.99 a month, so it is a valuable addition for anyone already paying for Ultra. There is one condition for sharing: the Ultra subscriber must be the manager of the family group. And the benefit is only for eligible countries.
Do you share one subscription with your family, or does each person have their own? 📺
